findings: Buddy has a continuous reclining torso behind his foreground head; two forepaws flank the muzzle, with folded rear anatomy reasonably occluded by body and blanket. B19 supports the low enlarged frontal head perspective.
Dark torso is now broad smooth planes, distinct from blanket texture; furnishings remain on ears, brows, muzzle and paws. No torso engraving or enlarged shag volume.

Basset, pug, scruffy terrier and Labrador nurse match the recovery ensemble. Sleeping basset and Buddy chin-down deliver the lying-down-important beat; clean clinic setting and separated bodies read clearly.

Buddy retains continuous moderately elongated trunk, neck and substantial legs; one forepaw is lifted in front of the supporting foreleg. Heather hand contacts his back and he leans toward her leg; neither human nor dog limbs fuse.
Neet has full narrow trunk, fine legs, projecting muzzle, broad ears and tiny nub. Both bodies have smooth short-coat shading; Buddy regional furnishings and tapering dark tail remain distinct.
Car and clinic doors place the supported pickup correctly. Buddy uncertain head tilt against attentive closed-mouth Neet conveys the two-Neets joke without drawing a literal duplicate.

Buddy emerges at shrub edge with continuous back, chest, neck and limbs. Near forepaw is planted and far foreleg bends behind it; foliage accounts for rear-paw occlusion. Neet stands on four distinct fine legs with full narrow torso and small nub.
Smooth close torso shading on both dogs separates from grass and leaves. Buddy ear/muzzle/brow furnishings remain regional, without the prior engraved body texture.

Leaf overlaps Buddy brow/forehead region, conveying the carried-out leaf; confused gaze and Neet sideways attention serve the specific shrub mishap. Heather remains in the garden background; no setting conflict.

Entire replacement rechecked: continuous moderately elongated Buddy torso and neck; two extended forelegs and two folded rear legs have coherent ownership and blanket support. Heather hand still grips blanket edge. No disconnected paws or extra limbs.

Smooth close torso shading remains on both dogs; Buddy furnished ears, brows, muzzle and paws remain regional. No engraved body fur reappeared. Neet has full narrow torso, fine legs, broad triangular ears and clean seated haunch silhouette with no projecting tail tuft.

Warm living-room setting, Heather tucking blanket, Buddy proud open-eyed smile and Neet deflated seated gaze match the placement immediately before Buddy closes his eyes. Blanket/carpet texture remains distinct from short coats. No material perspective, identity, finish or scene defect found.
